REQ-QTY.statement: A checkout accepts whole item quantities from 1 to 5 inclusive. It rejects all other quantities without updating the cart.

negative.title: Reject a fractional quantity
negative.action: Set item quantity to 2.5 with a current quantity of 3
negative.expected: A validation error is shown and quantity remains 3

REQ-DISCOUNT.statement: A discount from 0 to 20 percent inclusive is saved. A larger or negative discount is rejected without changing the saved discount.

positive.title: Save a typical discount
positive.expected: A 10 percent discount is displayed after reload

negative.title: Reject a negative discount
negative.action: With 10 percent saved, attempt to save a -1 percent discount
negative.expected: The change is rejected and 10 percent remains saved
